title: Tire width to rim internal width helper
description: Enter your tire width in millimetres and choose the rim system. Tube-type and tubeless-ready setups are not split into two width calculators here; tubular rims use a separate tubular tire and rim system. Always cross-check the specific recommendations from your rim and tire manufacturers.
empty: Enter a tire width to see a suggested rim internal width range.
sweetSpot: Sweet spot around {width} mm. For aggressive or technical riding, stay closer to the wider end of the range.
